BiblicalUsage: En-Rimmon is a place in Palestine. In Nehemiah 11:29, the text says "And at En-rimmon." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Rimmon matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Rimmon is one of them.
